ja.title: pH依存の結合選択性からT細胞の活性化を予測できるか
ja.summary: 二価anti-CD3抗体の公表EC50から親抗体で変換係数を校正し、未使用の改変体のCD69活性化EC50を予測する。
ja.seo_title: pH依存の結合とT細胞活性化
ja.seo_description: Jurkat結合と初代T細胞CD69活性化の公表EC50を再解析。親抗体だけで校正した変換式を改変体に適用し、予測の誤差を調べる。

en.title: Can pH-selective binding predict primary T-cell activation?
en.summary: A parent-calibrated EC50 transfer rule is tested on engineered bivalent anti-CD3 variants using published binding and CD69 summaries.
en.seo_title: Can binding selectivity predict T-cell activation?
en.seo_description: Published anti-CD3 EC50 summaries test whether a parent-calibrated binding-to-activation rule predicts engineered variants in two primary T-cell donors.
